arStrings.szText:
Different {c_important}Ritual Sites{/c} now spawn in the Pit, and special Materials can spawn in different environments:

{icon:bullet,1.2}{c_important}Choron's Blood{/c} appears in foliage dense regions
{icon:bullet,1.2}{c_important}Choron's Sweat{/c} appears in stony locations
{icon:bullet,1.2}{c_important}Choron's Tears{/c} appears in mystical places

Sacrificing these Materials at {c_important}Ritual Sites{/c} may grant Gold, Materials, Items, and more.
